calculation.description: Negates the trailing three-day return and scales it by the instrument's current 20-day realized volatility relative to its trailing 120-day median. Scaling is capped to preserve interpretability and limit outlier influence. All inputs are lagged/rolling and use no future data.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR remained positive in 2020-22 (0.06727/0.19334), 2023-24 (0.06518/0.18485), and 2025-26 (0.04179/0.11760). Small 15-instrument cross-section; results aggregate 1,745 dates with at least 8 valid instruments.
